name: network-command-refused-by-review
about: Build tools on, search off, ask_claude off. The model asks to run a network command that uploads a workspace file; the network reviewer (a non-streamed reply) rates it critical, so it is refused without a question and without running; the model answers. Covers the reviewer request (system prompt, <user_request>, <command>, <network> from the egress policy, the attached file) and the refusal the model reads.

stream.content: The upload was refused by the security review. Share notes.txt through your team's own channel.
